short_description: a serving of plain boiled broad beans
full_description: Plump broad beans sit in a shallow bowl, their pale skins wrinkled and their centres softened by plain boiling.
taste: The beans taste mild and earthy, with clean salt and a faint grassy finish.

short_description: a serving of salted broad bean mash
full_description: Broad beans have been crushed into a coarse beige mash, with salt crystals scattered across the damp spoon marks.
taste: Salty broad-bean richness fills the mouth, followed by a dry, nutty pulse note.

short_description: a serving of herbed broad bean mash
full_description: Green herb flecks brighten this rustic broad-bean mash, which retains small tender pieces among its smoother portions.
taste: Earthy beans are lifted by fresh herbs, leaving a green and gently peppery aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of onion-stewed broad beans
full_description: Whole broad beans nestle in an onion-rich cooking liquor, glossy and brown from a long, gentle simmer.
taste: Sweet cooked onion rounds the broad beans, while the broth finishes savoury and mellow.

short_description: a serving of garlic-roasted broad beans
full_description: Hearth-roasted broad beans show blistered skins and toasted corners, with minced garlic clinging to their warm surfaces.
taste: Toasted bean skins give way to creamy centres, with warm garlic lingering after each bite.

short_description: a serving of vinegar-dressed broad beans
full_description: A light vinegar dressing glistens over tender broad beans, collecting sharply scented droplets beneath the serving.
taste: Bright vinegar sharpens the soft beans, ending with salt and a restrained earthy sweetness.

short_description: a serving of broad beans with leeks
full_description: Soft broad beans are folded through pale leek ribbons, leaving the pulses whole enough to contrast with the yielding greens.
taste: Mellow beans and sweet leeks balance one another, with a soft vegetal finish.

short_description: a serving of broad beans with cabbage
full_description: Broad beans and wilted cabbage form a simple mottled heap, mixing creamy interiors with soft, crinkled leaves.
taste: The creamy pulses temper the cabbage's leafy savour and slight mineral bitterness.

short_description: a serving of broad bean and turnip pot
full_description: Turnip cubes and broad beans crowd a little cloudy broth, each piece rounded at the edges by slow cooking.
taste: Earthy broad beans meet mild turnip sweetness in a comforting, lightly salted broth.

short_description: a serving of broad bean herb patties
full_description: Small broad-bean patties have crisp brown faces and coarse, herb-speckled centres that crumble beneath a fork.
taste: These patties taste nutty and herbal, with pepper warmth beneath their toasted crusts.

short_description: a serving of plain boiled field peas
full_description: Field peas remain plump and distinct after boiling, their green-grey skins shining with a trace of cooking water.
taste: The field peas taste gently sweet and grassy, with only a simple salted close.

short_description: a serving of thick split pea pottage
full_description: Split peas have dissolved into a thick golden-green pottage, broken only by a few intact halves near the rim.
taste: Deep pea flavour dominates the thick pottage, finishing creamy, earthy, and faintly sweet.

short_description: a serving of thin split pea broth
full_description: Pale pea fragments drift through a thin, lightly clouded broth whose surface carries only a sparse herbal garnish.
taste: The broth offers a light pulse savour, touched by herbs and a modest pinch of salt.

short_description: a serving of minted green pea mash
full_description: Fresh mint streaks a smooth green pea mash, lending colour to the broad swirls left by the serving spoon.
taste: Sweet green peas carry cool mint across the palate, ending fresh rather than heavy.

short_description: a serving of roasted peas with salt
full_description: Dry-roasted peas gather in a crisp little heap, their dimpled surfaces dusted visibly with coarse salt.
taste: Crisp peas taste toasted and nutty, with coarse salt lingering on the lips.

short_description: a serving of pea and onion pottage
full_description: Yellow peas and translucent onion pieces share a dense pottage, with softened pulses thickening the liquor around them.
taste: Soft onion sweetness enriches the peas, producing a round savoury finish.

short_description: a serving of pea and leek pottage
full_description: Chopped leek threads curl through this heavy pea pottage, bringing pale green contrast to its otherwise earthy colour.
taste: The leeks add gentle allium sweetness to the dense, earthy pea base.

short_description: a serving of pea and cabbage pot
full_description: Soft cabbage ribbons lie among thick-cooked peas, making a spoonable pot with a little savoury liquor at the bottom.
taste: Cabbage lends leafy sweetness to the peas, while the reduced liquor ends mildly peppery.

short_description: a serving of pea and parsnip mash
full_description: Parsnip lightens this pea mash with ivory streaks, while small pulse fragments preserve a pleasantly coarse texture.
taste: Sweet parsnip softens the field-pea earthiness, leaving a creamy root finish.

short_description: a serving of peppered pea cakes
full_description: Peppered pea cakes have dark, pan-seared faces and soft green interiors where crushed peas remain clearly visible.
taste: Black pepper cuts through the sweet peas and follows the browned crust into the aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of brown lentil pottage
full_description: Brown lentils make a substantial pottage, with whole flat pulses suspended through a thick umber cooking liquor.
taste: The lentils taste earthy and substantial, with a mild pepper note from the thick broth.

short_description: a serving of red lentil mash
full_description: Red lentils have collapsed into a smooth ochre mash, its surface glossy and gently ridged from stirring.
taste: Red lentils give a creamy, slightly sweet flavour with a clean mineral finish.

short_description: a serving of lentils with onions
full_description: Soft lentils mingle with browned onion slivers, the separate pulses still visible beneath the sweet, translucent pieces.
taste: Caramelised onion sweetens the earthy lentils and leaves a mellow savour behind.

short_description: a serving of lentils with garlic
full_description: Minced garlic is worked through a mound of tender lentils, leaving pale aromatic specks across the dark pulses.
taste: Garlic gives the lentils a warm aromatic bite without obscuring their nutty depth.

short_description: a serving of lentils with wilted greens
full_description: Wilted greens thread between earthy lentils, their soft leaves adding deep olive folds to the loose serving.
taste: The greens add clean bitterness to the lentils, balanced by salt and earthy warmth.

short_description: a serving of lentils with roasted roots
full_description: Roasted root pieces rise from a bed of lentils, showing caramelised edges above the moist, dark pulses.
taste: Caramelised roots bring sweetness and toasted edges to the peppery lentil base.

short_description: a serving of sour lentil broth
full_description: A clear sour broth surrounds brown lentils, with tiny bubbles of vinegar collecting beside chopped herbs.
taste: Vinegar brightens the dark lentils, leaving the thin broth tart and appetite-wakening.

short_description: a serving of spiced lentil cakes
full_description: These lentil cakes are compact and well browned, revealing a coarse, spice-flecked middle where one has cracked.
taste: Warm spices run through the earthy cakes, followed by a toasted, peppery crust.

short_description: a serving of lentil and mushroom pot
full_description: Sliced mushrooms darken a thick lentil pot, their curved caps visible among the small pulses and reduced liquor.
taste: Woodland mushroom savour deepens the lentils, with onion and herbs lingering softly.

short_description: a serving of lentil-stuffed onions
full_description: Hollow onions cradle a dense lentil filling, their translucent layers folded closely around the pepper-speckled centre.
taste: Sweet onion layers yield to a peppery lentil filling with a rich, earthy centre.

short_description: a serving of boiled chickpeas
full_description: Boiled chickpeas make a pale, knobbly mound, each pulse tender yet firm enough to keep its rounded shape.
taste: Chickpeas taste nutty and gently sweet, finishing with plain salt and soft starch.

short_description: a serving of salted chickpea mash
full_description: Salted chickpeas are mashed to a sandy cream, with a few skins and broken halves giving the surface texture.
taste: The mash is creamy and savoury, with enough salt to sharpen its chickpea richness.

short_description: a serving of garlic chickpea paste
full_description: Garlic chickpea paste lies in a broad smooth sweep, marked by the spoon and dotted with tiny pale garlic pieces.
taste: Roasted garlic warms the nutty paste and leaves a mellow sweetness on the tongue.

short_description: a serving of herbed chickpea cakes
full_description: Hand-shaped chickpea cakes carry crisp brown crusts around moist, herb-filled centres of coarsely crushed pulses.
taste: Herbs freshen the rich chickpea centres, while the browned crust adds toasted depth.

short_description: a serving of roasted chickpeas
full_description: Roasted chickpeas have taut, golden skins and occasional dark spots where they sat closest to the hot pan.
taste: Dry, crisp skins taste warmly toasted before giving way to sweet, floury chickpea centres.

short_description: a serving of chickpeas with greens
full_description: Whole chickpeas are scattered through folded greens, pairing firm round pulses with soft, glossy leaves.
taste: Firm chickpeas bring nutty sweetness against the greens' mild, leafy bitterness.

short_description: a serving of chickpeas with onions
full_description: Chickpeas and onions form a warm rustic mixture, with browned allium edges winding between the pale pulses.
taste: Browned onions lend caramel sweetness to the chickpeas and a lingering savoury note.

short_description: a serving of chickpeas with turnips
full_description: Turnip chunks interrupt a bed of chickpeas, their white flesh softened enough to match the tender pulses.
taste: Turnip adds a clean root sweetness to the nutty pulses, with gentle salt at the finish.

short_description: a serving of sour chickpea relish
full_description: A sharp chickpea relish combines broken pulses with glossy chopped vegetables in a lightly clouded vinegar dressing.
taste: The relish tastes tart and lively, combining vinegar bite with creamy broken chickpeas.

short_description: a serving of chickpea and lentil pot
full_description: Chickpeas and lentils share a thick earthen pot, contrasting round pale pulses with smaller russet discs.
taste: Nutty chickpeas and peppery lentils make a rounded, earthy flavour with a hearty finish.

short_description: a serving of boiled cowpeas
full_description: Cowpeas rest in a little clear cooking liquor, their cream-coloured bodies marked by distinct dark eyes.
taste: Cowpeas taste mild and creamy, with a clean pulse flavour and restrained salt.

short_description: a serving of cowpea leaf stew
full_description: Tender cowpea leaves fold through a loose pulse stew, with softened beans appearing between the deep green ribbons.
taste: Leafy, slightly mineral greens lighten the cowpeas' soft earthiness and savoury broth.

short_description: a serving of cowpeas with millet greens
full_description: Millet greens make a leafy bed for whole cowpeas, mixing fine stems and dark leaves with pale speckled pulses.
taste: The millet greens contribute grassy bitterness beside the mild, creamy cowpeas.

short_description: a serving of black-eyed pea mash
full_description: Black-eyed peas have been worked into a coarse ivory mash, with their dark markings scattered through the ridged surface.
taste: The mash tastes earthy and full, with soft starch followed by a subtle bean sweetness.

short_description: a serving of pigeon pea pottage
full_description: Pigeon peas thicken this ochre pottage, though several whole pulses remain visible in the dense spoonful.
taste: Pigeon peas give the pottage a robust nutty taste and a warm pepper finish.

short_description: a serving of pigeon peas with roots
full_description: Soft root cubes are mixed with pigeon peas, adding pale angular pieces to the warm brown heap.
taste: Sweet roots mellow the firm pigeon peas, leaving an earthy and lightly toasted aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of mung bean mash
full_description: Mung beans form a moist greenish mash, smooth in places but still dotted with split skins and intact centres.
taste: Mung bean mash tastes delicate and grassy, with gentle salt and a creamy close.

short_description: a serving of mung beans with greens
full_description: Small mung beans sit among wilted greens, their mild pale bodies contrasting with glossy dark leaves.
taste: The mild beans absorb the greens' leafy savour, ending fresh and slightly mineral.

short_description: a serving of urad bean cakes
full_description: Urad bean cakes are seared nearly black at the edges, enclosing soft off-white centres speckled with cracked skins.
taste: Urad beans taste deep and earthy beneath a smoky crust, with pepper lingering afterward.

short_description: a serving of horse gram pottage
full_description: Horse gram has simmered into a dark, sturdy pottage, with firm little pulses distributed through the thickened broth.
taste: Horse gram brings a robust, dry pulse flavour softened by the savoury cooking broth.

short_description: a serving of white bean pottage
full_description: White beans have softened into a pale, thick pottage, with a few whole pulses rising through the creamy base.
taste: The pottage tastes creamy and mild, with earthy beans followed by a gentle salted finish.

short_description: a serving of red bean mash
full_description: Red beans are crushed into a rose-brown mash whose rough spoon marks still hold bits of skin and tender centres.
taste: Red bean earthiness fills the mouth, softened by starch and a faint natural sweetness.

short_description: a serving of black bean pot
full_description: Black beans crowd a dark cooking liquor, making a glossy pot with purple-black pulses visible beneath the steam.
taste: The black beans taste deep and mineral-rich, while the thick broth leaves a savoury warmth.

short_description: a serving of mottled bean stew
full_description: Mottled beans and small vegetable pieces fill this rustic stew, their varied skins distinct in the reduced broth.
taste: Each bean contributes a slightly different nuttiness to the peppered, vegetable-rich stew.

short_description: a serving of bean and onion hash
full_description: Browned onion and roughly crushed beans make a loose hash, crisp at the edges and moist through the middle.
taste: Caramelised onion sweetens the beans, and the crisp pan edges add a toasted aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of bean and leek mash
full_description: Pale leek ribbons wind through a coarse bean mash, leaving green-white streaks across its warm beige surface.
taste: Sweet leek lightens the dense bean mash, leaving a mellow allium note behind.

short_description: a serving of bean and cabbage pottage
full_description: Soft cabbage folds through a substantial bean pottage, with whole pulses suspended in the cloudy, leaf-sweet liquor.
taste: The beans provide earthy body while cabbage lends leafy sweetness and a clean finish.

short_description: a serving of bean and carrot pot
full_description: Orange carrot cubes brighten a dark bean pot, their neat edges softened among the plump, glossy pulses.
taste: Carrot brings gentle sweetness to the robust beans and softly seasoned broth.

short_description: a serving of bean and beet mash
full_description: Beetroot stains this bean mash a muted crimson, while pale broken beans give the mound a marbled appearance.
taste: Earthy beet and creamy bean flavours mingle, ending sweet, mineral, and faintly peppery.

short_description: a serving of bean-stuffed cabbage
full_description: Translucent cabbage leaves wrap a compact bean filling, and one open edge reveals the coarse, pepper-flecked centre.
taste: The cabbage tastes mild and sweet around a filling rich with beans, herbs, and pepper.

short_description: a serving of mixed pulse pottage
full_description: Several kinds of pulse share this thick pottage, creating a varied surface of round beans, split peas, and flat lentils.
taste: The pulses create layered earthy flavours, rounded by starch and a savoury broth.

short_description: a serving of three-pulse mash
full_description: Three pulses are worked into a coarse mottled mash, with different skins and colours preserved in every spoon ridge.
taste: Nutty beans, sweet peas, and peppery lentils combine in a dense, satisfying mash.

short_description: a serving of pea and lentil cakes
full_description: Small pea-and-lentil cakes show crisp brown faces and green-brown interiors packed firmly enough to hold together.
taste: Sweet pea and earthy lentil meet beneath a toasted crust with a warm herbal finish.

short_description: a serving of bean and chickpea stew
full_description: Round chickpeas and darker beans sit in a substantial stew, surrounded by a broth thickened with broken pulses.
taste: The chickpeas add creamy nuttiness to the darker beans and the rich cooking liquor.

short_description: a serving of lentil and chickpea mash
full_description: Lentils lend russet specks to a pale chickpea mash, which remains slightly coarse despite its creamy body.
taste: Peppery lentil balances the chickpea's soft sweetness, producing a rounded pulse flavour.

short_description: a serving of sprouted pulse salad
full_description: Short white sprouts curl among mixed pulses and chopped greens, making a fresh, crisp salad with a damp sheen.
taste: The sprouts taste fresh and grassy against the earthy pulses, with a brisk dressed finish.

short_description: a serving of toasted pulse crumble
full_description: Toasted fragments of several pulses form a dry golden-brown crumble, with irregular pieces ranging from meal to coarse grit.
taste: Dry toasted pulses taste nutty and smoky, leaving a pleasantly crisp, grain-like savour.

short_description: a serving of soured bean paste
full_description: A fermented bean paste lies in a glossy brown sweep, dense and smooth except for a scattering of softened skins.
taste: Fermentation gives the beans a deep sourness, backed by salt and lingering earthy richness.

short_description: a serving of pulse-and-herb dumplings
full_description: Plump dumplings have pale, tender skins around an herb-studded pulse filling that shows where one has split.
taste: Tender dough gives way to a savoury pulse centre brightened with chopped green herbs.

short_description: a serving of pulse-stuffed turnips
full_description: Hollow turnips hold a closely packed pulse mixture, their soft ivory walls contrasting with the darker filling.
taste: Sweet turnip surrounds an earthy, peppered pulse filling with a soft herbal aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of boiled cabbage wedges
full_description: Boiled cabbage wedges retain their layered shape, though the pale leaves bend easily and glisten with cooking water.
taste: The cabbage tastes gently sweet and mineral, with plain salt lingering in its tender layers.

short_description: a serving of buttered cabbage ribbons
full_description: Thin cabbage ribbons are glossy with melted butter, curling into soft folds with lightly browned tips.
taste: Butter rounds the cabbage's leafy flavour and adds richness to the browned ends.

short_description: a serving of vinegar cabbage salad
full_description: Shredded cabbage remains crisp beneath its vinegar dressing, forming a bright heap of pale and green strands.
taste: Vinegar gives the crisp cabbage a lively sour bite, followed by clean vegetal sweetness.

short_description: a serving of cabbage and leek pot
full_description: Cabbage and leek pieces settle into a little savoury liquor, both vegetables cooked until tender but still recognisable.
taste: Sweet leeks soften the cabbage flavour, while the broth finishes mild and savoury.

short_description: a serving of cabbage with mustard seed
full_description: Mustard seeds dot the softened cabbage leaves like dark beads, collecting particularly in the moist folds.
taste: Peppery mustard seed punctuates the soft cabbage with warm, slightly bitter sparks.

short_description: a serving of charred cabbage quarters
full_description: Quartered cabbage bears blackened outer edges from the hearth, while the layered hearts remain pale and succulent.
taste: Char lends smoky bitterness to the outer leaves before the sweet heart comes through.

short_description: a serving of stuffed cabbage leaves
full_description: Broad cabbage leaves enclose a coarse vegetable filling, with tied folds holding each compact parcel together.
taste: The tender leaf wrapper gives way to a savoury filling of vegetables, herbs, and pepper.

short_description: a serving of salted cabbage mash
full_description: Salted cabbage has been worked into a pale green mash, its fibrous texture still visible beneath the wet surface.
taste: Salt sharpens the cabbage mash, whose flavour remains leafy, mild, and faintly sweet.

short_description: a serving of cabbage and onion hash
full_description: Chopped cabbage and onion make a rough pan hash, showing caramelised corners among the softer, glossy pieces.
taste: Browned onion enriches the cabbage with caramel sweetness and a toasted pan savour.

short_description: a serving of cabbage heart broth
full_description: A clear, pale broth surrounds tender pieces cut from the cabbage heart, with fine leaf shreds drifting near the surface.
taste: The broth tastes delicate and cabbage-sweet, with a light herbal and mineral finish.

short_description: a serving of braised kale greens
full_description: Braised kale lies in dark green folds, glossy with cooking liquor and softened along every thick central rib.
taste: Kale brings robust leafy bitterness, mellowed by slow cooking and a savoury liquor.

short_description: a serving of wilted spinach leaves
full_description: Spinach leaves collapse into a delicate emerald heap, with fine stems and darker folds preserving some structure.
taste: The spinach tastes delicate and green, with soft mineral notes and restrained salt.

short_description: a serving of boiled chard with garlic
full_description: Broad chard ribbons float beside slices of garlic, their pale stalks firmer than the deep green leaves.
taste: Garlic warms the earthy chard, while the stalks contribute a clean vegetal sweetness.

short_description: a serving of mustard greens pot
full_description: Mustard greens fill a shallow pot with olive ribbons and tender stems, all coated in a lightly clouded liquor.
taste: Mustard greens taste peppery and pleasantly bitter, ending with savoury cooking liquor.

short_description: a serving of turnip greens with onions
full_description: Turnip greens and translucent onions form a soft leafy tangle, with pale allium slivers visible between the stems.
taste: Sweet onion tempers the turnip greens' bitterness and leaves a mellow finish.

short_description: a serving of beet greens mash
full_description: Beet greens make a dark, fibrous mash streaked crimson where chopped stalks have coloured the surrounding leaves.
taste: Beet stalks add earthy sweetness to the dark greens and their mineral-rich mash.

short_description: a serving of nettle greens pottage
full_description: Nettle leaves thicken this green pottage, their softened edges disappearing into a dense, herbaceous base.
taste: The nettle pottage tastes intensely green and earthy, with herbs lifting its dense body.

short_description: a serving of sorrel leaf stew
full_description: Sorrel cooks down into a loose olive stew, with narrow leaves and tender stems gathered in a tart-smelling liquor.
taste: Sorrel gives the stew a bright natural tartness over soft, grassy leaf flavours.

short_description: a serving of dandelion leaf salad
full_description: Jagged dandelion leaves remain lightly wilted in this dressed salad, keeping their deep green colour and toothsome ribs.
taste: Dandelion bitterness remains lively and clean, sharpened by dressing and a touch of salt.

short_description: a serving of mallow greens broth
full_description: Soft mallow leaves drift through a clear green broth, their natural mucilage lending the liquid a slight body.
taste: Mallow tastes mild and leafy, while its thickened broth leaves a soft herbal finish.

short_description: a serving of boiled turnip chunks
full_description: Turnip chunks sit in a simple drained heap, their ivory faces rounded by boiling and damp with residual steam.
taste: Boiled turnips taste clean and gently sweet, with a mineral note beneath the salt.

short_description: a serving of mashed turnips
full_description: Mashed turnips form a pale, loose mound, with fibrous flecks and shallow hollows left by the wooden spoon.
taste: The mash is mild and earthy, finishing with turnip sweetness and a faint pepper warmth.

short_description: a serving of roasted turnip wedges
full_description: Roasted turnip wedges have tawny caramelised faces, creamy centres, and darker corners from the hot pan.
taste: Caramelised surfaces add toasted sweetness before the creamy turnip centre takes over.

short_description: a serving of vinegar-glazed turnips
full_description: A translucent vinegar glaze coats the turnips, pooling in their cut surfaces and catching the light around browned edges.
taste: Sharp vinegar cuts through the root sweetness and leaves a lively, glazed finish.

short_description: a serving of turnips with herbs
full_description: Chopped herbs cling to tender turnip pieces, scattering green flecks over their softly steamed ivory flesh.
taste: Fresh herbs brighten the mellow turnips with green fragrance and gentle pepper.

short_description: a serving of turnip and onion hash
full_description: Diced turnip and browned onion make a moist hash, with crisp pan marks appearing among the yielding pieces.
taste: Browned onion deepens the turnip's sweetness, while crisp edges lend toasted savour.

short_description: a serving of turnip and leek mash
full_description: Leek gives pale green streaks to this turnip mash, which is smooth at the centre and rougher around the edges.
taste: Leek adds soft allium sweetness to the earthy mash and a fresh green aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of turnip with wilted greens
full_description: Soft turnip pieces rest beneath wilted greens, combining pale root cubes with dark, glossy leaf ribbons.
taste: The turnip tastes softly sweet beneath greens that bring mild bitterness and minerals.

short_description: a serving of hollowed stuffed turnip
full_description: A large turnip has been hollowed into a sturdy cup, its cavity packed with a coarse savoury vegetable filling.
taste: The tender turnip shell surrounds a richly savoury filling of vegetables and herbs.

short_description: a serving of charred baby turnips
full_description: Baby turnips show blistered purple-white skins and blackened tips, while their small centres remain juicy and tender.
taste: Charred skins taste smoky and faintly bitter around the sweet, juicy young roots.

short_description: a serving of boiled parsnip batons
full_description: Parsnip batons lie in a pale drained stack, their sharp-cut corners rounded and softened by boiling.
taste: Boiled parsnip tastes gently sweet and earthy, with simple salt and a clean root finish.

short_description: a serving of mashed parsnips
full_description: Mashed parsnips form an ivory mound with a fibrous grain, shallow spoon furrows, and occasional firmer flecks.
taste: The mash is creamy yet fibrous, carrying parsnip sweetness and a mild pepper warmth.

short_description: a serving of honeyed roast parsnips
full_description: Honeyed parsnip pieces show lacquered amber faces and caramelised tips around their soft white centres.
taste: Honey deepens the roasted root sweetness, while caramelised edges leave a toasted aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of parsnip and onion mash
full_description: Brown onion streaks marble a creamy parsnip mash, leaving darker sweet fragments in the roughly worked root.
taste: Sweet onion rounds the parsnip mash and adds a mellow savour beneath its earthy flavour.

short_description: a serving of parsnip herb cakes
full_description: Small parsnip cakes have crisp golden crusts and moist, herb-flecked middles with a visible root texture.
taste: Herbs lift the sweet parsnip centres, and the browned crust contributes nutty warmth.

short_description: a serving of parsnip and cabbage pot
full_description: Cabbage ribbons fold around tender parsnip chunks in a shallow pot, with a little cloudy liquor beneath.
taste: Parsnip sweetness mingles with cabbage's leafy character in a mild, comforting broth.

short_description: a serving of parsnip with lentils
full_description: Flat brown lentils are scattered among parsnip pieces, contrasting earthy pulses with pale, softened root.
taste: Earthy lentils temper the parsnip's sweetness and leave a substantial peppery finish.

short_description: a serving of vinegar-dressed parsnips
full_description: Thin parsnip slices glisten beneath a clear vinegar dressing, their edges still crisp despite brief cooking.
taste: Vinegar brings a brisk tang to the crisp root, followed by clean sweetness and salt.

short_description: a serving of charred parsnip roots
full_description: Whole parsnip roots carry black hearth streaks and blistered skins, splitting to reveal fluffy ivory flesh.
taste: The blackened skin tastes smoky and bitter before giving way to a fluffy, sweet centre.

short_description: a serving of parsnip and leek hash
full_description: Chopped leek and parsnip make a rough pan hash, with browned corners appearing among soft green-white pieces.
taste: Caramelised leek enriches the parsnip pieces with soft allium sweetness and toasted edges.

short_description: a serving of boiled carrot rounds
full_description: Carrot rounds keep their bright orange colour after boiling, though their edges yield easily beneath a fork.
taste: The carrots taste clean and naturally sweet, with a gentle mineral note after the salt.

short_description: a serving of roasted carrots with herbs
full_description: Roasted carrots lie in an irregular heap, marked by dark caramelised lines and scattered chopped herbs.
taste: Roasting concentrates the carrot sweetness while fresh herbs provide a fragrant green finish.

short_description: a serving of carrot and onion mash
full_description: Soft carrot and browned onion have been crushed together, producing a vivid mash streaked with translucent pieces.
taste: Browned onion lends savoury depth to the soft carrot mash and its rounded sweetness.

short_description: a serving of vinegar carrot salad
full_description: Fine carrot strips make a crisp orange salad, shining under vinegar and dotted with small herb fragments.
taste: The salad tastes bright and tart, with crisp carrot sweetness lingering after the vinegar.

short_description: a serving of carrot and cabbage pot
full_description: Carrot chunks brighten a cabbage pot of pale folded leaves, with both vegetables sitting in a modest broth.
taste: Sweet carrot balances the mild cabbage, and the light broth ends softly vegetal.

short_description: a serving of carrot with peas
full_description: Green peas nestle among tender carrot coins, making a bright serving of round pulses and softened root.
taste: Pea sweetness complements the carrots, creating a fresh flavour with a grassy finish.

short_description: a serving of honey-glazed carrots
full_description: A thin honey glaze coats roasted carrots, pooling in their ridges and darkening the narrow, caramelised ends.
taste: Honey makes the carrots lush and sweet, checked by the smoky taste of roasted tips.

short_description: a serving of charred carrot roots
full_description: Charred carrot roots retain blackened skins along one side, while their split centres remain vivid and moist.
taste: Smoke and slight bitterness mark the skin before the juicy carrot centre turns sweet.

short_description: a serving of carrot and lentil mash
full_description: Orange carrot threads run through a coarse lentil mash, breaking the brown surface with sweet, softened pieces.
taste: Earthy lentil gives body to the carrot mash, which finishes sweet and gently peppered.

short_description: a serving of stuffed braised carrots
full_description: Large carrot sections have been hollowed and braised around a dense savoury filling visible at each open end.
taste: The braised carrot tastes tender and sweet around a savoury, herb-seasoned filling.

short_description: a serving of boiled beetroot wedges
full_description: Boiled beetroot wedges form a damp crimson heap, their smooth cut faces staining the serving liquor purple-red.
taste: Beetroot tastes earthy and deeply sweet, leaving a strong mineral note on the tongue.

short_description: a serving of roasted beetroots
full_description: Whole roasted beetroots have wrinkled dark skins and tender ruby interiors exposed by several natural splits.
taste: Roasting gives the beets dark caramel sweetness and a faintly smoky skin.

short_description: a serving of sour beetroot salad
full_description: Chopped beetroot and greens make a jewel-dark salad, slicked with sour dressing and edged by crisp pieces.
taste: Sour dressing sharpens the beet's sweetness, while the greens leave a clean bitter edge.

short_description: a serving of beetroot and onion mash
full_description: Sweet onion is folded through a coarse beetroot mash, leaving pale translucent strips across its deep red surface.
taste: Sweet onion mellows the earthy mash and adds a soft caramel flavour to the finish.

short_description: a serving of beetroot with cabbage
full_description: Beetroot cubes stain soft cabbage leaves magenta, creating a moist mixture of dense root and folded greens.
taste: Cabbage lightens the dense beetroot with leafy sweetness and a mild vegetal close.

short_description: a serving of beetroot lentil patties
full_description: Crushed lentils bind grated beetroot into squat crimson patties whose ridged faces have browned against the pan.
taste: Earthy pulses temper the beet's mineral sweetness, with toasted edges adding a savoury finish.

short_description: a serving of salt-baked beetroots
full_description: A crust of coarse salt covers each baked beetroot, cracking away from the softened skin in white crystalline patches.
taste: Salt intensifies the baked beet's earthy sweetness and draws out a rich, concentrated flavour.

short_description: a serving of beetroot leaf parcels
full_description: Broad beet leaves enclose small savoury parcels, with crimson stems crossed neatly over their dark green folds.
taste: The leaves taste gently bitter around a tender filling enlivened by beet-stem sweetness.

short_description: a serving of peppered beetroot hash
full_description: Diced beetroot and onion form a rough scarlet hash, its pan-browned edges dusted visibly with black pepper.
taste: Black pepper warms the sweet beetroot hash, with browned onion deepening its savour.

short_description: a serving of beetroot and leek broth
full_description: Fine leek rings and beetroot pieces drift through a clear ruby broth, settling in colourful layers around the spoon.
taste: The broth is light but earthy, carrying beet sweetness and a mellow leek fragrance.

short_description: a serving of braised leeks
full_description: Braised leeks lie in long silky lengths, their pale centres translucent and their green ends softened to olive.
taste: Braised leeks taste silky and sweet, with a delicate allium savour and restrained salt.

short_description: a serving of charred leeks
full_description: Leek sections show charred outer stripes and blistered tips, with moist concentric layers visible where they split.
taste: Char adds smoky bitterness to the outer leek, followed by a creamy sweet centre.

short_description: a serving of leek and onion pottage
full_description: Leek and onion cook down into a pale glossy pottage, their soft ribbons almost disappearing into the thick base.
taste: Leek and onion combine into a mellow, sweet pottage with a lingering savoury warmth.

short_description: a serving of leek and cabbage mash
full_description: Soft cabbage and leek have been worked into a green-white mash whose folded strands remain faintly discernible.
taste: The cabbage lends leafy body to the leek mash, which finishes mild and softly sweet.

short_description: a serving of leeks with mustard
full_description: Whole mustard seeds cling to tender leek lengths, dotting the glossy pale surfaces with brown and yellow specks.
taste: Mustard seeds bring brief peppery bursts through the tender, sweet allium layers.

short_description: a serving of vinegar-dressed leeks
full_description: Vinegar catches the light on thin leek ribbons, which retain a little spring despite their softened edges.
taste: Sharp vinegar brightens the leek's gentle sweetness and leaves a fresh, clean finish.

short_description: a serving of stuffed leek rolls
full_description: Wide leek strips wrap around a coarse filling, making compact rolls with tucked ends and browned seams.
taste: The soft leek wrapper yields to a savoury centre rich in herbs and pepper.

short_description: a serving of leek and mushroom pot
full_description: Sliced mushrooms darken a loose leek pot, their curved caps resting among pale rings in the savoury liquor.
taste: Mushrooms add woodland depth to the sweet leeks and their reduced cooking liquor.

short_description: a serving of leek and pea mash
full_description: Crushed peas tint this leek mash light green, while fine allium strands run through its thick, spooned surface.
taste: Sweet leek threads freshen the pea mash, leaving a light green allium aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of roasted leek hearts
full_description: Roasted leek hearts show caramel-brown outer layers curling away from tender, almost creamy centres.
taste: Caramelised outer leaves taste toasted and sweet around the mellow roasted heart.

short_description: a serving of baked onions
full_description: Baked onions sit whole and bronze-skinned, their softened layers opening slightly around sweet, translucent hearts.
taste: Baking concentrates the onion's sweetness, producing a soft savour with faint roasted bitterness.

short_description: a serving of boiled onions with herbs
full_description: Boiled onion quarters gleam with cooking water and chopped herbs, each curved layer tender but still intact.
taste: Herbs make the boiled onions fragrant, while their tender layers remain mellow and sweet.

short_description: a serving of charred onion halves
full_description: Halved onions bear blackened cut faces and crisp rims, enclosing soft layers made amber by the fire.
taste: The charred face brings smoke and bitterness before the onion layers turn richly sweet.

short_description: a serving of onion and garlic mash
full_description: Onion and garlic have been crushed into a pale golden mash, with browned fragments and glossy aromatic juices throughout.
taste: Roasted garlic strengthens the onion mash with warm pungency and a caramel finish.

short_description: a serving of vinegar onion relish
full_description: A vinegar-bright onion relish combines translucent slivers with crisp white pieces in a clear, sharply scented dressing.
taste: Vinegar cuts sharply through the onion sweetness, leaving the relish crisp and lively.

short_description: a serving of stuffed onions with pulses
full_description: Hollow onions hold a dense mixture of beans and lentils, their tender outer layers cupping the mottled pulse filling.
taste: Sweet onion surrounds an earthy pulse filling seasoned with herbs and gentle pepper.

short_description: a serving of onion and cabbage hash
full_description: Chopped onion and cabbage make a moist skillet hash, with browned allium pieces caught among the pale leaf shreds.
taste: Browned onion deepens the cabbage hash with caramel sweetness and toasted savour.

short_description: a serving of onion and turnip pot
full_description: Onion petals and turnip cubes share a shallow pot, both softened in a clear broth without losing their outlines.
taste: Turnip lends clean root sweetness to the onions and their lightly salted broth.

short_description: a serving of onion greens salad
full_description: Tender onion greens are cut into short bright lengths, lightly dressed and piled with their hollow stems visible.
taste: The greens taste fresh, grassy, and mildly sharp beneath their simple dressing.

short_description: a serving of slow-braised onion pot
full_description: Slow braising has reduced onions to silky amber petals, which settle into a rich brown liquor around the bowl.
taste: Long cooking makes the onions richly sweet and savoury, with the dark liquor lingering.

short_description: a serving of roasted garlic bulbs
full_description: Whole garlic bulbs emerge from roasting with papery bronze skins and soft cloves pushing through their split tops.
taste: Roasting turns the garlic sweet and mellow, with toasted skins adding a faintly bitter finish.

short_description: a serving of garlic and herb paste
full_description: Crushed garlic and chopped herbs make a glossy green-flecked paste, spread in thick ridges across a small dish.
taste: The paste tastes pungent and green, as fresh herbs soften the garlic's lingering heat.

short_description: a serving of boiled garlic cloves
full_description: Boiled garlic cloves lie pale and plump in a drained heap, their smooth surfaces yielding at the slightest pressure.
taste: Boiled cloves are mild, creamy, and surprisingly sweet, leaving only gentle garlic warmth.

short_description: a serving of garlic greens pottage
full_description: Chopped garlic greens thicken a pale pottage, with hollow stems and soft leaves visible through the cloudy base.
taste: The pottage carries a fresh allium bite, rounded by soft greens and starchy broth.

short_description: a serving of garlic and bean mash
full_description: Creamy beans are mashed with roasted garlic, leaving pale aromatic streaks and scattered bean skins across the mound.
taste: Earthy beans absorb the roasted garlic, producing a creamy savour with warm aromatic depth.

short_description: a serving of garlic-stuffed mushrooms
full_description: Large mushroom caps cradle a minced garlic filling, their browned rims curling around the moist pale centres.
taste: Woodland mushroom and sweet garlic combine beneath browned edges and a moist savoury centre.

short_description: a serving of soured garlic relish
full_description: Finely chopped garlic sits in a sharp, cloudy relish, with translucent pieces glistening under the sour dressing.
taste: Sour dressing sharpens the garlic, leaving a lively pungency followed by salt and herbs.

short_description: a serving of charred garlic shoots
full_description: Garlic shoots bear black hearth marks along their green stems, while the thicker white ends remain moist and tender.
taste: Charred shoots taste smoky and green, with sweet garlic emerging from the tender white ends.

short_description: a serving of garlic and leek broth
full_description: Fine garlic slices and leek rings drift through a clear golden broth, gathering in pale aromatic clusters.
taste: The broth is delicate but fragrant, balancing leek sweetness with clean garlic warmth.

short_description: a serving of garlic cabbage parcels
full_description: Folded cabbage leaves form compact parcels around a garlic-rich filling, their seams browned where they touched the pan.
taste: Sweet cabbage surrounds a strongly garlicky filling softened by herbs and browned savour.

short_description: a serving of boiled radish roots
full_description: Boiled radish roots keep their round pink-white forms, though their skins have dulled and their centres turned tender.
taste: Boiling mellows the radish bite into clean root sweetness with a faint peppery echo.

short_description: a serving of roasted radishes
full_description: Roasted radishes show wrinkled red skins and caramel-brown patches, with creamy white flesh visible in split roots.
taste: Roasted radishes taste sweet and juicy, while caramelised skins contribute gentle bitterness.

short_description: a serving of radish leaf pottage
full_description: Radish leaves have cooked into a loose green pottage, their fine stems suspended in a lightly thickened liquor.
taste: The leafy pottage tastes green and mineral-rich, with subdued radish pepper in the finish.

short_description: a serving of sour radish salad
full_description: Thin radish slices and chopped greens form a crisp salad, shining under a clear sour dressing.
taste: Vinegar heightens the radish sharpness, making the crisp salad bright and refreshing.

short_description: a serving of radish and onion hash
full_description: Diced radish and onion make a rough skillet hash, with translucent allium caught among pink-edged root pieces.
taste: Browned onion sweetens the peppery radish and leaves a toasted skillet flavour behind.

short_description: a serving of radish with peas
full_description: Green peas scatter between softened radish halves, adding bright round shapes to the pale, lightly glazed roots.
taste: Sweet peas soften the radish heat, creating a fresh, grassy, and lightly peppered dish.

short_description: a serving of braised radish greens
full_description: Braised radish greens lie in dark olive folds, with softened stems still lending structure to the glossy heap.
taste: The greens taste robust and slightly bitter, mellowed by braising and savoury liquor.

short_description: a serving of salted radish relish
full_description: Salted radish pieces crowd a moist relish, their crisp pale interiors framed by red skin and clear brine.
taste: Salt and brine sharpen the crisp radish pieces without hiding their natural pepperiness.

short_description: a serving of stuffed radish cups
full_description: Hollow radish roots serve as small white cups, each packed with a finely chopped savoury filling.
taste: The root cup tastes mild and fresh around a richer filling of herbs and vegetables.

short_description: a serving of charred winter radish
full_description: A large winter radish carries a blackened outer crust, cracked in places to expose steaming white flesh.
taste: Char gives the winter radish a smoky crust before its hot, peppery centre comes through.

short_description: a serving of baked squash halves
full_description: Baked squash halves hold pools of golden flesh inside browned shells, with spoon marks scoring their soft centres.
taste: Baking concentrates the squash sweetness and adds a nutty roasted note near the shell.

short_description: a serving of mashed winter squash
full_description: Winter squash has been worked into a dense orange mash, its silky surface broken by a few fibrous strands.
taste: The mash tastes creamy and sweet, with earthy squash depth and a warm spice finish.

short_description: a serving of roasted squash cubes
full_description: Roasted squash cubes have caramel-dark edges and vivid golden faces, piled loosely with their soft corners intact.
taste: Caramelised edges bring toasted sweetness to the soft, mellow squash centres.

short_description: a serving of squash and onion pot
full_description: Soft squash pieces and amber onion petals settle in a shallow pot, surrounded by a little sweet cooking liquor.
taste: Sweet onion reinforces the squash and leaves the reduced liquor rich but not heavy.

short_description: a serving of squash with lentils
full_description: Brown lentils dot a bed of squash, giving the bright soft pieces an earthy, speckled appearance.
taste: Peppery lentils ground the squash sweetness with earthy pulse flavour and soft starch.

short_description: a serving of squash and bean mash
full_description: Beans are crushed through golden squash to make a marbled mash, creamy overall but still showing skins and small chunks.
taste: Beans make the squash mash hearty and nutty while preserving its gentle sweetness.

short_description: a serving of stuffed squash bowl
full_description: A thick squash shell forms a broad edible bowl around a densely packed filling of vegetables and herbs.
taste: The roasted shell tastes sweet and firm around a savoury filling rich with herbs.

short_description: a serving of vinegar squash relish
full_description: Chopped squash gleams in a pale vinegar relish, its small firm pieces scattered with seeds and green herbs.
taste: Vinegar cuts through the squash sweetness, leaving the relish tart, herbal, and clean.

short_description: a serving of charred summer squash
full_description: Summer squash sections carry striped black char across their green skins, with moist pale centres beneath.
taste: Smoky char marks the skin, followed by the mild juicy flavour of summer squash.

short_description: a serving of squash blossom parcels
full_description: Delicate squash blossoms wrap a finely chopped filling, their golden petals folded into tender little parcels.
taste: The tender blossom tastes delicate and green around a warmly seasoned vegetable centre.

short_description: a serving of boiled gourd pieces
full_description: Boiled gourd pieces form a pale translucent heap, each clean-cut section softened yet still holding its outline.
taste: Boiled gourd tastes very mild and watery, with clean salt and a faint vegetal sweetness.

short_description: a serving of gourd and chickpea pot
full_description: Chickpeas and gourd cubes share a thick pot, combining round pale pulses with glassy, tender vegetable pieces.
taste: Nutty chickpeas give body to the soft gourd and its gently seasoned cooking liquor.

short_description: a serving of stuffed bottle gourd
full_description: A long bottle gourd has been hollowed and filled, with a cut end exposing the coarse savoury mixture inside.
taste: The gourd remains mild and tender, allowing the savoury herb-filled centre to dominate.

short_description: a serving of gourd with leafy greens
full_description: Dark leafy greens fold around softened gourd pieces, adding deep colour to the pale, watery vegetable.
taste: Leafy bitterness and mineral notes enliven the gourd's soft, almost neutral flavour.

short_description: a serving of sour gourd relish
full_description: Diced gourd and herbs sit in a cloudy sour relish, with vinegar beading across the crisp-edged pieces.
taste: The relish tastes briskly sour, with crisp gourd carrying salt and chopped herbs.

short_description: a serving of roasted gourd slices
full_description: Roasted gourd slices show golden-brown faces and damp, almost translucent centres beneath their thin skins.
taste: Roasting adds nutty sweetness to the otherwise mild gourd and lightly browns its finish.

short_description: a serving of gourd and lentil mash
full_description: Lentils give a russet grain to this pale gourd mash, which remains moist and slightly coarse beneath the spoon.
taste: Earthy lentil lends depth to the moist gourd mash, followed by pepper and herbs.

short_description: a serving of spiced gourd cakes
full_description: Small gourd cakes have browned pan crusts and soft, spice-flecked centres that hold together when broken.
taste: Warm spices and browned crust enrich the mild gourd centre with aromatic savour.

short_description: a serving of braised young gourds
full_description: Young gourds lie whole in a glossy braising liquor, their green skins wrinkled around very tender flesh.
taste: Young gourds taste fresh and faintly sweet beneath a glossy, herb-scented braise.

short_description: a serving of dried gourd stew
full_description: Rehydrated strips of dried gourd curl through a dark stew, their chewy brown edges distinct in the thick broth.
taste: The dried strips bring concentrated vegetal sweetness and chew to the savoury stew.

short_description: a serving of boiled aubergine
full_description: Boiled aubergine pieces sit in a glossy purple-grey heap, with collapsed skins clinging to their soft pale flesh.
taste: Boiled aubergine tastes mild and silky, with a slight bitterness under simple salt.

short_description: a serving of charred aubergine mash
full_description: Charred aubergine is crushed into a smoky beige mash, streaked with black skin and marked by broad spoon swirls.
taste: Smoke permeates the creamy mash, balanced by sweet flesh and a pleasantly charred finish.

short_description: a serving of roasted aubergine slices
full_description: Thick aubergine slices bear browned, blistered faces and creamy interiors that sag gently at the edges.
taste: Roasting makes the aubergine rich and nutty, with browned surfaces over a soft centre.

short_description: a serving of aubergine and chickpea pot
full_description: Whole chickpeas appear between cubes of aubergine in a substantial pot, the soft vegetable darkening the broth.
taste: Chickpeas add nutty firmness to the yielding aubergine and its dark savoury broth.

short_description: a serving of aubergine with onions
full_description: Silky aubergine strips mingle with amber onion petals, making a moist heap with dark skins and translucent pieces.
taste: Sweet onion deepens the silky aubergine, leaving a mellow caramel and herb finish.

short_description: a serving of sour aubergine relish
full_description: Small aubergine pieces glisten in a tart relish, their purple skins contrasting with pale flesh and chopped herbs.
taste: Sharp vinegar brightens the soft aubergine pieces and clears their slight bitterness.

short_description: a serving of stuffed aubergine
full_description: A hollow aubergine encloses a coarse vegetable filling, with its roasted skin drawn close around the open seam.
taste: The aubergine shell tastes smoky and tender around a substantial savoury filling.

short_description: a serving of aubergine and lentil mash
full_description: Lentils are folded through a smooth aubergine mash, leaving earthy brown specks in the smoky, creamy base.
taste: Peppery lentils add earthiness to the creamy aubergine and prolong its smoky finish.

short_description: a serving of braised baby aubergines
full_description: Baby aubergines sit whole in dark braising liquor, their taut purple skins wrinkled around tender centres.
taste: The baby aubergines taste rich and slightly bitter, softened by sweet braising liquor.

short_description: a serving of smoked aubergine paste
full_description: Smoked aubergine paste spreads in a pale grey-brown layer, threaded with charred skin and glossy aromatic oil.
taste: Deep smoke and roasted sweetness dominate the paste, with garlic lingering gently.

short_description: a serving of stewed okra pods
full_description: Stewed okra pods lie in a glossy green heap, their ridged sides softened and their cut ends thickening the liquor.
taste: Okra gives the stew a green, slightly grassy flavour and a pleasantly thick, savoury finish.

short_description: a serving of roasted okra
full_description: Roasted okra has blistered green skins and browned tips, with the slender pods still firm enough to hold their shape.
taste: Roasting adds nuttiness and smoke to the mild pods, with browned tips tasting faintly bitter.

short_description: a serving of okra and cowpea pot
full_description: Cowpeas dot a thick okra pot, their pale round bodies surrounded by sliced pods and a lightly thickened broth.
taste: Earthy cowpeas lend body to the okra and its soft, herb-seasoned cooking liquor.

short_description: a serving of sour okra relish
full_description: Finely cut okra shines in a cloudy sour relish, with pale seeds suspended among the crisp green pieces.
taste: Vinegar makes the okra bright and tart, while the seeds leave a mild vegetal sweetness.

short_description: a serving of okra with leafy greens
full_description: Dark leafy ribbons fold around tender okra pods, creating a moist mixture of deep greens and pale seeded centres.
taste: The greens contribute clean bitterness beside the okra's mellow flavour and thickened juices.

short_description: a serving of charred okra pods
full_description: Whole okra pods carry blackened ridges from the hearth, while their split interiors remain green and succulent.
taste: Char marks the ridges with smoke before the tender pod releases its mild green savour.

short_description: a serving of okra and onion stew
full_description: Translucent onion petals settle among sliced okra in a loose stew whose broth has taken on a gentle thickness.
taste: Sweet onion rounds the okra stew, leaving a mellow allium note in the thick broth.

short_description: a serving of stuffed okra
full_description: Large okra pods are split and packed with a coarse savoury filling, then closed around the visible spiced centre.
taste: The okra tastes fresh and grassy around a filling warmed by herbs, pepper, and vegetables.

short_description: a serving of dried okra pottage
full_description: Dried okra rounds have softened in a dense pottage, retaining curled edges and a darker green-brown colour.
taste: Dried okra brings concentrated vegetal flavour and gentle chew to the dense pottage.

short_description: a serving of okra and lentil broth
full_description: Small lentils drift beside okra slices in a clear broth, with released seeds gathering near the spoon.
taste: Peppery lentils deepen the light okra broth, which finishes earthy and faintly herbal.

short_description: a serving of boiled asparagus spears
full_description: Boiled asparagus spears lie in a neat green bundle, their tips soft and their thicker stalks still faintly crisp.
taste: The spears taste clean and green, with gentle sweetness and a lightly mineral finish.

short_description: a serving of roasted asparagus
full_description: Roasted asparagus has browned scales and wrinkled tips, with a light sheen across the tender green stalks.
taste: Roasted asparagus tastes nutty and grassy, followed by a mild bitterness from the browned scales.

short_description: a serving of asparagus and leek pot
full_description: Pale leek rings and asparagus sections fill a shallow pot, both vegetables resting in a little clear liquor.
taste: Sweet leek softens the asparagus flavour and leaves the clear broth aromatic and mellow.

short_description: a serving of vinegar asparagus salad
full_description: Short asparagus pieces make a bright salad under vinegar, their cut stalks glossy and their tips intact.
taste: Vinegar sharpens the fresh asparagus, giving the crisp salad a lively green finish.

short_description: a serving of asparagus with peas
full_description: Round peas gather between chopped asparagus stems, pairing bright green pulses with darker pointed tips.
taste: Sweet peas complement the grassy stalks and leave a soft, springlike aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of charred asparagus tips
full_description: Asparagus tips bear fine black char along their scales, while the small centres remain moist and vivid.
taste: The tips taste smoky and slightly bitter outside, then sweet and tender within.

short_description: a serving of braised asparagus stems
full_description: Braised asparagus stems lie in a loose stack, lacquered with cooking liquor and softened without turning limp.
taste: Braised stalks taste mellow and vegetal, carrying savoury liquor and restrained salt.

short_description: a serving of asparagus and herb mash
full_description: Chopped asparagus and herbs form a coarse green mash, with fibrous stalk pieces visible beneath the spoon marks.
taste: Fresh herbs brighten the fibrous asparagus mash and leave a fragrant green aftertaste.

short_description: a serving of asparagus with mushrooms
full_description: Sliced mushrooms rest among asparagus lengths, their brown curved caps contrasting with the narrow green stems.
taste: Woodland mushroom depth balances the asparagus, with both ingredients remaining clearly distinct.

short_description: a serving of salted asparagus relish
full_description: Salted asparagus pieces crowd a moist relish, with pale cut ends and darker tips shining under light brine.
taste: Salt intensifies the grassy pieces, while the moist relish ends clean and slightly sharp.

short_description: a serving of roasted field mushrooms
full_description: Field mushrooms emerge from roasting with puckered brown caps, dark gills, and crisp edges around juicy centres.
taste: Roasting concentrates the mushrooms' woodland savour and gives their edges a toasted finish.

short_description: a serving of boiled mushroom pottage
full_description: Boiled mushrooms thicken a brown pottage, their pale stems and soft caps visible in the cloudy cooking liquor.
taste: The pottage tastes dark and earthy, with softened mushrooms enriching its mild broth.

short_description: a serving of mushroom and onion hash
full_description: Chopped mushrooms and onions make a dark skillet hash, with caramelised fragments caught among moist cap pieces.
taste: Caramelised onion sweetens the mushroom hash and leaves a rich browned-pan flavour.

short_description: a serving of mushroom-stuffed leeks
full_description: Blanched leek leaves have been wrapped around chopped mushrooms, making pale green parcels with dark filling at each cut end.
taste: The tender leek tastes softly sweet around a juicy, peppered mushroom centre.

short_description: a serving of garlic mushrooms
full_description: Whole mushrooms are glossy with garlic and pan juices, their browned caps gathered around pale aromatic pieces.
taste: Garlic warms the juicy mushrooms, lingering aromatically after their earthy savour fades.

short_description: a serving of vinegar mushroom salad
full_description: Thin mushroom slices lie under a sharp vinegar dressing, keeping springy edges and clearly patterned gills.
taste: Vinegar gives the springy mushrooms a brisk edge and clears their deeper woodland flavour.

short_description: a serving of stuffed mushroom caps
full_description: Broad mushroom caps enclose a coarse filling, with browned rims framing the packed herbs and vegetables.
taste: The tender cap releases earthy juices around a filling rich with herbs and vegetables.

short_description: a serving of dried mushroom broth
full_description: Dried mushroom pieces darken a clear broth, their curled leathery edges expanding around pale softened centres.
taste: Dried mushrooms make the broth deeply savoury, with a clean woody note after swallowing.

short_description: a serving of charred oyster mushrooms
full_description: Oyster mushrooms have charred frilled edges and golden-brown faces, while their clustered stems remain tender.
taste: Charred frills taste smoky and crisp around the oyster mushrooms' delicate, juicy flesh.

short_description: a serving of lentil-stuffed mushrooms
full_description: Broad mushroom caps cradle a coarse lentil filling, their rims darkened and curled by the oven's heat.
taste: Peppery lentils give the yielding mushrooms a nutty body and a faint herbal finish.

short_description: a serving of pickled cabbage
full_description: Pickled cabbage packs tightly into pale folded shreds, translucent with brine and still crisp along thicker ribs.
taste: The cabbage pickle tastes sour and salty, with a crisp leafy sweetness underneath.

short_description: a serving of pickled turnips
full_description: Turnip pieces sit beneath clear pickle liquor, their ivory interiors edged by softened purple or tan skin.
taste: Sharp brine lifts the turnip's clean sweetness and leaves a dry mineral finish.

short_description: a serving of pickled carrots
full_description: Carrot sticks retain their bright orange colour in brine, with sharp corners and tiny bubbles on the surface.
taste: Pickled carrots remain sweet beneath the vinegar, ending crisp, bright, and lightly salty.

short_description: a serving of pickled beetroots
full_description: Beetroot wedges stain their pickle liquor ruby, showing dense dark flesh through the clear glassy dressing.
taste: The beets taste intensely earthy and sweet against a tart, ruby-coloured pickle.

short_description: a serving of pickled onions
full_description: Curved onion petals float in pale brine, translucent at the edges while their white centres remain crisp.
taste: Vinegar cuts through onion sweetness, leaving the petals sharp, juicy, and refreshing.

short_description: a serving of pickled garlic cloves
full_description: Whole garlic cloves gleam ivory beneath the pickle, plump and smooth with occasional green herb fragments.
taste: Pickling mellows the garlic heat into a tangy sweetness with an aromatic finish.

short_description: a serving of pickled radishes
full_description: Radish rounds crowd the relish in red-rimmed layers, their pale centres shining with clear salted vinegar.
taste: The radishes stay peppery and crisp, sharpened further by salt and clear vinegar.

short_description: a serving of pickled mushrooms
full_description: Pickled mushrooms retain rounded brown caps and pale stems, packed closely in a dark herb-speckled brine.
taste: Sour brine brightens the mushrooms while preserving their mild, earthy depth.

short_description: a serving of mixed root pickle
full_description: Carrot, turnip, beet, and radish pieces form a colourful root pickle, each cut retaining its own shape.
taste: Each root contributes a different sweetness or pepperiness beneath the shared tart brine.

short_description: a serving of mixed green pickle
full_description: Several leafy greens share a cloudy pickle, their folded strips ranging from bright green to deep olive.
taste: The greens taste sour, salty, and faintly bitter, with their leaf character intact.

short_description: a serving of roasted mixed roots
full_description: Roasted roots make a warm variegated heap, with pale, orange, and red pieces carrying caramelised corners.
taste: Caramelised edges give the roots deep sweetness, toast, and gentle earthy bitterness.

short_description: a serving of boiled garden vegetables
full_description: Boiled garden vegetables fill a plain bowl with softened roots, greens, and pods in naturally muted colours.
taste: The vegetables taste plain and wholesome, with clean salt and varied garden sweetness.

short_description: a serving of mashed root medley
full_description: Several roots have been mashed together into a marbled mound, blending ivory, orange, and earthy red streaks.
taste: Different roots combine creamy sweetness, mineral earthiness, and a softly peppered finish.

short_description: a serving of charred vegetable platter
full_description: A mixed vegetable platter shows blackened edges, blistered skins, and tender centres across its varied pieces.
taste: Smoke and char deepen the vegetables while their tender centres remain naturally sweet.

short_description: a serving of leafy garden pottage
full_description: Leafy vegetables and small root pieces thicken this green pottage, with soft ribbons curling around the spoon.
taste: The pottage tastes leafy and nourishing, with root sweetness beneath a mild herbal bitterness.

short_description: a serving of mixed vegetable hash
full_description: Diced garden vegetables make a rough pan hash, showing browned faces among moist, brightly coloured pieces.
taste: Browned surfaces add toast and savour to the mixture's otherwise fresh vegetable flavours.

short_description: a serving of stuffed garden leaves
full_description: Broad cooked leaves wrap portions of chopped vegetables, with folded seams securing each tender green parcel.
taste: The leaf wrappers bring gentle bitterness around a sweet, herb-seasoned vegetable filling.

short_description: a serving of sour vegetable relish
full_description: Finely chopped vegetables glisten in a sour relish, their varied colours visible through the sharp clear dressing.
taste: Vinegar makes the relish lively and clean, with sweet roots balancing sharper green pieces.

short_description: a serving of herbed vegetable cakes
full_description: Small vegetable cakes have crisp herb-dotted crusts and coarse centres of chopped roots, greens, and pulses.
taste: Herbs enliven the vegetable cakes, while their browned crusts add nutty toasted depth.

short_description: a serving of garden vegetable stew
full_description: Root cubes, leafy strips, and tender pods share a substantial stew, each still recognisable in the savoury broth.
taste: The stew combines earthy roots, green leaves, and sweet pods in a rounded savoury broth.
